$comment: Host notes of the independent review mechanism (docs/dev/independent-review-spec.md A7), read by observe in skills/hep-authoring/scripts/review.py. P1 covers Claude Code only. Paths use ~ for the home folder, <project> for the project root and <project-slug> for the project path with '/' replaced by '-'. Entries marked inferred are not from the host documentation and need maintainer confirmation; session_start.obtainable is false, so isolation_not_yet_effective is never raised and the report says the setting's effect cannot be confirmed (spec 7.3, last paragraph).

isolation.docs: Sub-agents docs, section 'Let Claude wait for a subagent': after setting it, run claude again from your shell, or open a new VS Code conversation
The docs say this rule prevents Claude from starting a fork, but not when it takes effect: a warning, with the R0 isolation self-check as the fallback

claude-code.dispatch_note: Name a non-fork subagent type when dispatching, whichever method is used.

session_start.note: No documented way to read the host session start time; observation input may supply it

conditional.note: v2.1.277 or later; read only when neither the working directory nor a parent has CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md or CLAUDE.local.md (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md does not count), unless the Project instructions setting says otherwise

instruction_files.imports: files pulled in by @path from any of the above
instruction_files.subagent_definition: the subagent definition file used for dispatch, with its memory and omitClaudeMd fields
